main_text.head: NVPTIALIS CONCIO I. EX CAP. GENES. 2.
Textus explicandus.
main_text.p: DIXIT quoq; dominus Deus: Non est bonum hominem esse solum: faciam ei adiutorium quasi coram eo. Formatus igitur dominus Deus de humo cunctis animantibus terræ & uniuersis volatilibus cæli, adduxit ea ad Adam, vt videret quid vocaret ea. Omne enim quod vocauit Adam animæ viuentis, ipsum est nomen eius. Appellauitq; Adam nominibus suis cuncta animantia, & uniuersa volatilia cæli, & omnes bestias terræ. Adæ vero non inueniebatur adiutor oportunus. Immisit ergo Dominus deus soporem in Adam: cumq; obdormisset, tulit vnam de costis eius, & repleuit carnem pro ea. Et adificauit Dominus deus costam, quã tulerat de Adam, in mulierem: & adduxit eam ad Adam. Dixitq; Adam, Hoc nũc os ex ossibus meis, & caro de carne mea. Hac vocabitur virago, quoniam de viro sumpta

page.notes: The initial D is a large woodcut initial; read as "DIXIT". Words "vocaret" and "vocauit" are printed with a tall-s-like mark above the V in the scan and are copied as printed. The final word "pta" is the catchword-like fragment at the foot and is a partial word, kept as printed. The page-level running head is taken from the title line. Greek and Hebrew: none on this page.
